description: This file defines the ConvergenceException class, which extends MathIllegalStateException, representing an error related to non-convergence in numerical methods within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: ConvergenceException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a numerical computation fails to converge to a finite value.

methods.name: ConvergenceException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard convergence failure message.

methods.name: ConvergenceException(Localizable pattern, Object... args)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message pattern and arguments to detail the context of the convergence failure.
